page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.large is an x86_64 compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 16 physical cores, providing a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio with no hyperthreading. This hardware configuration ensures dedicated CPU allocation, delivering predictable processing power for workloads requiring consistent execution speeds.

The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. It also does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance for compute-intensive workloads that do not require massive memory footprints, such as batch processing, web serving, and distributed analytics.
